reviews.reviewText:
MCQs are from past papers 
Subjective was easy 2 programming questions 
And remaining questions are theoretical

Questions:
1. Name and explain two categories of application binary resources.
2. C# code: Declare grid length in auto sizing mode.
3. CALL code: Ensure size of all columns in grid are same.
4. Objective-C code: Interface of a car (Name, model, Id, setters).
5. C# code: Async lambda expression to divide two numbers.
6. C# code: Create and start a new thread.
7. Objective-C code: Create instance of NSMutableArray using alloc method.
